LanguageData.TSA_WD_DescIntelLos: Limit what you and factions know on the world map: hidden sites, scouting, and uncertain raid planning.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderFeatureGateTip: Turn on Fog of War above. Map fog, discovery, and scouts start right away when enabled. Activates only controls when raids use imperfect knowledge.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_EnableSettlementIntelTip: Off: full map knowledge. On: undiscovered sites and travelers stay hidden until spotted, and NPC scouts can run. Activates (below) only gates when raids use imperfect knowledge. Disabling mid-game may need a reload if overlays linger.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_DisableRestartTip: Fog of War disabled. Reload the save if FoW overlays linger.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_GateSettlementIntelTip: Never turns the feature off even if Fog of War is enabled. Always, From Mid, or From Late: discovery and scouts from day 0; raid knowledge fog starts when that stage is reached.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerColoniesAlwaysKnown: Player colony always known to all factions
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerColoniesAlwaysKnownTi: When off, other factions must discover your colony through line of sight from settlements, travelers, or scouts. When on, your colony stays known to every faction.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_NotifyJumpUndiscovered: Notifications may point to undiscovered settlements
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_NotifyJumpUndiscoveredTip: When off, letters name faction and ETA only and do not jump to undiscovered origins on the map. When on, full labels and map jumps are allowed.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_UncoverOnRaid: Uncover settlements when they raid you
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_UncoverOnRaidTip: When on, a settlement that launches a raid at you is discovered on the world map (with a short fog reveal) before the incoming raid letter, so the letter can name it and offer Jump Attacker. When off, raider origins stay fogged unless you already know them.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ListUndiscoveredTravelers: List undiscovered travelers in WD tabs
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ListUndiscoveredTravelersTi: When off, Active Travelers and similar lists hide hostile travelers you have not discovered. Your own travelers always show.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ThreatKnownOnly: Calculate threat based on known only
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ThreatKnownOnlyTip: When on, the world threat alert and diplomacy threat totals only count hostile settlements you have discovered. When off, threat uses full map knowledge even with Fog of War on.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TradersRequireKnownTip: When on, WD traders only pick neutral or allied destinations the sending faction has discovered. When off, traders keep perfect destination knowledge even with Fog of War on.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_SpottedCaravansRemainVisibl: When off, discovered travelers hide again after leaving sight. When on, they stay on the map (dimmed) until destroyed.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderSightRings: Line of sight and Hunch range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderSightRingsTip: Every observer has two distances. Line of sight: clear tiles, bright icons, and discover anything. Hunch range: grey explored tiles, dim icons, and discover Tier 3+ settlements plus stronger WD caravans. Same rules for settlements, travelers, scouts, and your colony.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_LosFrac: Line of sight (% of Hunch range)
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_LosFracTip: Line of sight as a share of Hunch range. Inside LOS you spot everything. Between LOS and Hunch range you only spot Tier 3+ settlements and WD caravans at or above the T2 strength slider (Tier 2 sites need Line of sight).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderSettlementLosTip: NPC settlements use their tier for Hunch range (Line of sight is the percent below of that). Your colony and outposts grow both ranges with each free colonist or occupant. Age and game stage then scale Hunch range up to the multiplier below. Expert attack-range bonuses do not apply.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_SettlementLosMaxMultTip: At Late stage and maximum age, Hunch range reaches baseline times this value (Line of sight scales with it). Half of the growth comes from age, half from Mid or Late stage. Expert attack-range bonuses do not apply.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderTravelerLosTip: Traveler Hunch range and size class come from departure strength. Attrition never changes class. Medium+ travelers (T2 strength and up) can be spotted from Hunch range; weaker ones only inside Line of sight.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT1Tip: Hunch range for the weakest traveler class (their Line of sight is the LOS percent of this).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT2Tip: Hunch range for class T2 travelers.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT3Tip: Hunch range for class T3 travelers.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerMaxLosT4Tip: Hunch range for the strongest traveler class.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerStrengthT2Tip: WD caravans at or above this departure strength are medium (Hunch-spottable). Also the AT long-range fire threshold (outer accuracy band).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerStrengthT3Tip: Travelers at or above this departure strength are class T3.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_TravelerStrengthT4Tip: Travelers at or above this departure strength are class T4.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutMaxLosTip: Scout and player caravan Hunch range for spotting medium+ targets and exploring tiles. Line of sight is the LOS percent of this (small targets only inside that). Scout strength does not change this range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutSpeedMultTip: How much faster NPC and player scouts move than regular walking WD caravans. 1.20 = 20% faster. NPC Stable buildings can still speed them further.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerCaravanMaxLosTip: Unused. Player caravans use Scout Hunch range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderScoutsStrategicTip: NPC scouts launch when Fog of War is enabled. Strategic Expand settings live under Growth and Expansion.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_WeightScoutTip: How often settlements try to launch scouts on the daily action roll. Higher means more scouting relative to other actions.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutClearWeightMultTip: When the settlement's attack range has no known hostiles, scout weight is multiplied by this.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutStrengthMinTip: Minimum departure strength for a scout. Kept at or above the T2 class boundary so scouts stay long-range AT eligible.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutStrengthMaxTip: Maximum departure strength for a scout.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutCooldownDaysTip: Per-settlement cooldown after launching a scout.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutCrackFallTip: Chance that an NPC interceptor lets a scout through without fighting. Player intercepts are unchanged.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ScoutBearingAvoidTip: Scouts avoid launching toward directions that already have a known hostile within this cone.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_WeightStrategicExpandTip: How often Strategic Expand runs on the daily action roll. Founding prefers safe tuck-away tiles outside nearby enemy sight, away from paths to the nearest hostiles, and not toward the player. Uses true knowledge of nearby hostiles.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_StrategicExpandSamplesTip: How many candidate tiles Strategic Expand samples before picking the safest tuck-away site.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_HeaderGotBurnedTip: After a raid undercounts defenders, the next plan against that same target inflates known defender strength (caution only).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_BurnedHiddenPctTip: After a raid undercounts defenders, the next plan against that target inflates known defender strength by this percent (caution only; no free neighbor discovery).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_GotBurnedDaysTip: How long the Got Burned caution lasts on a target before it expires.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_BurnTriggerRatioTip: If true defender strength exceeds the fogged estimate by this ratio, stamp Got Burned on the attacker.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_ShowSightRadiusDesc:
Hex fill over fog.

Line of sight: {0} tiles
Hunch range: {1} tiles

You see everything within Line of sight. At Hunch range you still spot Tier 3+ settlements and WD caravans with {2}+ strength (Tier 2 sites need Line of sight). AT turrets and advanced buildings need Line of sight.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_ShowSightRadiusDescPlayer:
Hex fill over fog for this outpost.

Line of sight: {0} tiles
Hunch range: {1} tiles

You see everything within Line of sight. At Hunch range you still spot Tier 3+ settlements and WD caravans with {2}+ strength (Tier 2 sites need Line of sight). Undiscovered sites can stay hidden.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_ShowSightRadiusDescPlayerCo:
Hex fill over fog for your colony.

Line of sight: {0} tiles
Hunch range: {1} tiles

You see everything within Line of sight. At Hunch range you still spot Tier 3+ settlements and WD caravans with {2}+ strength (Tier 2 sites need Line of sight).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_SightRadiusBandsLegend: Bright gold = Line of sight ({0} tiles): clear tiles, bright icons, discover anything.\nSofter gold = Hunch range ({1} tiles): grey shroud, dim icons, Tier 3+ sites and WD caravans with {2}+ strength.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_SightScale_Pawns: Each pawn adds {0} Line of sight and {1} Hunch range (before age and Late-stage growth).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Gizmo_SightScale_SettlementTier: NPC settlement Hunch range uses its tier baseline (Line of sight is the LOS percent of that). Age and Late stage can grow both further.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ViewAsPlayerTip: Reset to your discovery fog (normal play when Fog of War is on).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ViewAsTip: Debug only. View the map as another faction's discovery. Your fog is the default when Fog of War is enabled.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_ShowFogOfWarTip: When on: clear tiles = Line of sight; grey = Hunch or remembered explore; black = unexplored. Hides undiscovered sites and landform names. When off, the map draws fully visible (debug). Session only.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_PrepareTimeNeed: Prepare time: need at least one pawn.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_BuildTip: Click a tile for the first scout destination. Shift+click more waypoints; click to confirm muster.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_SelectTiles: Click a tile for one destination, or Shift+click waypoints then click to confirm muster.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_AlreadyActive: Only one scout may be active at a time from this colony or outpost.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScoutMaxLifetimeDaysT: How long a player scout caravan may stay on the world map before it is removed. Outpost upgrades can add bonus days later.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_LifetimeExpired: {0} reached max scout lifetime and returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Letter_PlayerScoutDestroyed_Text: {0} was destroyed on the world map.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Letter_PlayerScoutLifetimeExpired: {0} reached max scout lifetime and returned.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_NeedStrength: Need at least {0} strength to dispatch a scout.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_NeedPawns: Need at least one pawn to prepare a scout.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_NeedTiles: Select at least one scout destination tile.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_NoReachable: No reachable scout tiles in the queue.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_CancelDesc: Abort scout preparation. No strength spent until launch.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Intel_PlayerScout_CancelTravelerD: Immediately dismiss this scout caravan. Strength already spent is not refunded.
